name: BC550
description: Low-noise NPN in the European BC546-550 family, the low-noise 45V member (the BC549/BC550 are the low-noise siblings of BC547/BC548). Same TO-92 C-B-E pinout. Complement to the BC560.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: C-B-E (BC546-550 family layout). Opposite of the 2N3904.

extra.gain groups: B/C suffix; C is highest gain

typical_application: Low-noise audio input/preamp stages where device noise matters (microphone/phono front ends), and general small-signal NPN use.
gotchas: pinout is C-B-E, the REVERSE of the American 2N3904 (E-B-C)
the low-noise spec is the reason to pick BC549/BC550 over BC547/BC548; otherwise similar
commonly stocked as the high-gain C suffix
